title: Loop+ Usage Goodwill Credit in Marketplace Orders Guarantee Grants
content:
**Schedule.** The Loop+ usage credit of the Marketplace Orders guarantee grant counts the benefit uses on the buyer's Loop+ ledger, each use counting when the whole calendar months from its date to the decision date are fewer than the usage window of 12 months: at least the heavy-usage count of 20 uses earns the heavy-usage credit of USD 5.00; at least the regular-usage count of 10 but fewer than 20 earns the regular-usage credit of USD 2.50; fewer earn no usage credit.

Each goodwill credit of the guarantee grant is decided on its own; it is added together with any other goodwill credit of the grant, and what is paid of the credits is added to the amount claimed.

The entries counted are benefit uses recorded on the buyer's Loop+ Membership ledger.

## Credit by benefit uses

| Benefit uses counted (fewer than 12 whole months before the decision date) | Credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 5.00 |
| 10 to 19 | 2.50 |
| 0 to 9 | 0.00 |

### Hypothetical boundary

19 uses in the window earn USD 2.50; a 20th use in the window raises the credit to USD 5.00. A use dated 11 whole months and some days before the decision date counts; one dated 12 whole months or more before does not.
